verdict.rationale: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM so users can ask natural-language questions and get insights from their documents, including multi-document comparisons. Annotations add AI-generated figure captions and chart-to-table conversions. These insights are query-driven, delivered through the API with a playground, and there is no documented proactive suggestion feature. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, an in-product insights surface beyond API/playground, independent hands-on corroboration of the QnA insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: This allows you to extract information and insights from documents by asking questions in natural language.
The Document QnA capability combines OCR with large language model capabilities to enable natural language interaction with document content.
The user may ask to describe/caption the figure for instance.
